settings.title: Where’s my order?
settings.text: Every tee is made to order. We’ll email your tracking link when your order is ready to ship, so you can follow it all the way to your door.

settings.question: When will my order ship?
settings.answer: Made to order. Delivery timing varies by destination. We’ll email your tracking link when your order is ready to ship.

settings.question: Can I track my order?
settings.answer: Yes. Once your order ships, we’ll email you a tracking link so you can follow your tee all the way to your door.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.answer: Yes. Free shipping on orders $99+. Shipping policy

settings.question: What if I don’t love my shirt?
settings.answer: Don’t love your clothing for any reason? Contact us within 30 days of the original purchase for a refund. No return needed—donate it or share it with a friend.

settings.question: I ordered the wrong size.
settings.answer: Wrong T-shirt size? Contact us within 30 days of the original purchase and we’ll send you a new T-shirt in your requested size. No return needed.

settings.question: What is the tee made of?
settings.answer:
We print on Comfort Colors® 1717: substantial 6.1 oz, 100% ring-spun cotton. The garment-dyed fabric has a soft, lived-in feel from the first wear.

Prefer a lighter tee? Many designs also come in Gildan® Softstyle® 64000, a lightweight 4.5 oz tee with a smooth, soft feel.

settings.question: How do I wash it?
settings.answer: Machine wash cold, inside out. Tumble dry low or hang dry. Skip the bleach and keep the iron off the print.

settings.question: Where is OldyFans based?
settings.answer: OldyFans is based in the USA, and our tees are printed right here in the States.

settings.question: How does it fit?
settings.answer: Comfort Colors® 1717 has a relaxed unisex fit, with room through the body for an easy, laid-back feel. Lay your favorite tee flat, measure straight across from armpit to armpit, and compare it with the chart below.

settings.question: Size charts
settings.note: Published garment dimensions. Size tolerance: ±1.5 in.

settings.question: Can I request a design?
settings.answer: Please do. Tell us the song, the show or the saying you grew up with. We can’t promise every idea, but we read every note. Send it here.
